title: Painting a Postal Service Delivery Truck
content: What is the history and future of the USPS delivery trucks? I do the job of sketch-reporter to find out. (Link to YouTube view)This truck is one of the commonplace things we've seen every day for 30 years. But once they take them all away, we'll miss seeing them, just like we miss the yellow Checker cab and the phone booth.------Watch the 11 minute video onYouTube
